'''PT-IF Protocol Torsos''' were lightweight (17 kg) droid torsos with medium [[Battery/Legends|battery]] capacity made by [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]]. They were made of [[alumina]], [[Aluminium/Legends|aluminium]], and [[Rubber/Legends|rubber]], which means they weren't magnetic. They had a medium durability and were designed to look somewhat feminine.
